texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_INDOSTAN_ATACANTE: A rich plain of fields and groves between the river and the stream. The stream can be forded, but it will slow our men; the bridges are few.
The enemy holds the temple and its village by the river. Take it and the province is ours.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_INDOSTAN_DEFENSOR: The enemy comes across the plain. Let them wade the stream under our guns.
Hold the temple and the village around it. While they stand, the province stands.
